artworks.title: The Great Heroic Landscape, Dedicated to Schiller
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with dramatic chiaroscuro effects, contrasting light and shadow. In the foreground, a group of figures is amidst rocky terrain and lush foliage. Dark, swirling clouds fill the sky, hinting at an impending storm. The horizon is low, leading to a town in the valley. Rolling hills stretch to rugged mountains in the background. The intricate details of flora, rocks, and light play are created using fine engraving techniques. The monochromatic color palette enhances the somber atmosphere.

artworks.title: Sleeping Greyhound
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a large, slender dog lying on its side on the ground. The color palette is primarily brown tones, varying from deep brown to lighter beige shades, giving the appearance of a sepia drawing. The dog's head is positioned towards the left side of the image, with its body curving around and its tail laying closely against its rear on the right side. The background is a desolate, textured surface.

artworks.title: Mangrove Scene
artworks.medium: photogravure
artworks.description: The image displays a swamp with tall, bare cypress trees towering over the still water, reflecting the trees. Vertical lines of the trees draw the eye upwards into the dense canopy. The sepia-toned image shows a muted color palette with browns and blacks dominating the scene. Closest to us, smaller plants and foliage are visible, contrasting with the smooth water's surface. In the background, the density of the trees suggests a deep, expansive forest.

artworks.title: Grave
artworks.medium: photogravure
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Daniel Joseph and Family
artworks.description: There is a gravestone on the right side of the image. On the left side, there are cups, bottles, an oil lamp, and a clock. The color palette is muted, with gray and beige tones, creating a sepia effect. In the foreground, there are glass and ceramic objects scattered on the ground with fallen leaves.

artworks.title: Taj Mahal
artworks.medium: watercolor and pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a straight-on view of a grand architectural structure resembling the Taj Mahal. The building is centrally framed with surrounding vegetation obscuring the horizon. The painting features detailed brushstrokes capturing the intricate designs and ornate embellishments of the building. The symmetrical placement of domes and minarets, with the main dome in the center, is depicted. A garden path flanked by cypress trees leads towards the building, surrounded by lush green trees. The color palette is bright with whites, greens, and light browns. The architecture showcases geometric patterns and decorative elements typical of Mughal architecture, blending with the garden scene.

artworks.title: Seated Figure of Death with an Hourglass
artworks.artist: Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Virginia Mars

artworks.title: Skeleton of a Hedgehog
artworks.artist: Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Virginia Mars
artworks.description: This is an image of an animal skeleton. The detailed skeletal structure of an animal is shown in a side profile, walking on a surface. The bones are outlined, with emphasis on the ribcage, spine, and leg bones. Each bone is connected appropriately, reflecting an anatomical study of the creature. Above the skeleton, there is text in Latin. At the bottom right, there is a signature.

artworks.title: Net Menders
artworks.medium: drypoint printed in red on laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: The image features two figures seated close to the viewer, with a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is suggested by the landscape behind a distant wagon. It is a line drawing with fine, flowing lines detailing clothing, hair, and the surroundings. The color palette is limited to sepia or reddish-brown tones. The composition directs the viewer's gaze from the figures in the foreground to the landscape in the background.

artworks.title: Woman with the Basket or Potato Harvester
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman depicted from her head to her mid-calves, engaged in a bending position. Her head is turned downward, and her long dark hair is tied back, with a few strands blowing across her face. She is wearing a long-sleeved dress that appears to be made of a dark, heavy fabric. She is holding a basket with her right hand and a sack in her left, which is placed on the ground. Her shoes are visible, appearing as light-colored clogs. The background consists of an open field with a building or structure faintly visible on the horizon, under an overcast sky.

artworks.title: Landscape with Trees on a Bluff and a Snake Remarque
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in dark brown and black on chine appliqué on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal landscape viewed from an elevated position. The horizon is low in the composition with the sky meeting the water. The artist uses swirling brushstrokes for a dynamic effect, notably in the sky and foliage. The color palette is subdued, featuring shades of gray, brown, and white. The scene includes stone formations, a cliff silhouette, and wind-swept trees. The distant view captures the sea and sky with an emphasis on light and shadow.

artworks.title: Two White Egrets
artworks.medium: lithograph on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows two long-necked birds standing in a natural setting. The drawing features two birds, detailed feather work, long beaks, and foliage in the background. The lines and shading accentuate the birds' plumage and the environment, creating a serene scene. The background includes subtle line work suggesting a natural habitat, such as a marshland or riverside.

artworks.title: Bronze Toad (Crapaud Bronze)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and drypoint on Chinese, gold-flecked yellow paper
artworks.description: The image displays a large amphibian-like creature in the lower center with a textured pattern covering its body. There is a smaller blobby form above it to the left. The color palette includes a sepia tone background and black ink for the illustrations, with red printed patterned elements near the bottom. The amphibian is the focal point of the image, while the smaller form appears ethereal, floating above it. In the bottom left and right corners are sections of ornate red stamps or prints.

artworks.title: The Wave (La Vague)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and drypoint with burnishing on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virgina and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image shows ocean waves crashing into rocky cliffs from an elevated point of view. Dark, swirling clouds partially obscure the horizon. Bold brushstrokes depict the dynamic water with swirls and dark shapes. The color palette is monochromatic, with deep blacks, grays, and creamy whites. Dark, jagged rocks are in the foreground, contrasting with the sea foam against the cliffs. The scene conveys a sense of power and texture.

artworks.title: The Large Hanging Raven
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Lawrence Lawver
artworks.description: The image depicts a bird laying on its side with wings spread out. The bird's feathers are black, against a light background. The bird's body extends diagonally across the frame, with its head pointing left and its tail pointing right.

artworks.title: The Cumaen Sibyl
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper, laid down on a mount
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed within platemark): 17 × 12.9 cm (6 11/16 × 5 1/16 in.)
mount: 20 × 17.5 cm (7 7/8 × 6 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a scene with a figure, a small animal, a tree, distant architectural structures, a river, and the sun. The figure holds an object and the animal is sniffing the ground. The scene shows a harmonious blend of natural and human-made elements. The drawing is detailed and showcases skilled draughtsmanship.

artworks.title: Peasants Fighting over a Game of Cards
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman, after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within the platemark): 43 × 52.4 cm (16 15/16 × 20 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural scene with human interaction. The scene shows individuals engaged in an interaction near a path in a village setting with thatched-roof buildings in the background. The foreground includes a fallen wooden structure, a helmet, and scattered playing cards. There is a sense of motion and emotion, hinting at conflict or drama. The area is surrounded by leafless trees, creating a chaotic atmosphere. The drawing is detailed with high contrast between the figures and the background, capturing the expressions and movements of each figure.

artworks.title: The Seine at Bas-Meudon
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The etching depicts a riverbank scene with a wooden fence and trees on the left, leading to the water's edge. In the distance, buildings and vegetation line the horizon, with hills and treetops merging with structures. Delicate lines depict foliage and water, creating texture. The monochrome color palette relies on shading for depth. Boats are docked on the riverbank in the distance.

artworks.title: Fisherman with a Net
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows a shoreline framed by dense vegetation with a narrow boat near the shore. The horizon is slightly above the center of the image, featuring a cluster of trees and bushes. The style uses fine and delicate etching techniques with intricate line work. The black and white color scheme creates strong contrast, emphasizing details of the vegetation and water's surface. The trees are densely packed, outlined with line work suggesting leaves and branches. The foreground is water with land rising slightly behind it, covered in vegetation. Trees provide height against an empty sky.

artworks.title: The Sawmill of Bas-Meudon
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a view from the water's edge near a cluster of small boats. Houses are seen on a gently sloping hillside in the distance, arranged linearly up the bank with foliage around them. The style is of an etching with fine, precise lines, conveying details and texture without color. The color palette is limited, using light and dark tones to capture the scene in a monochromatic manner.

artworks.title: The Dyer's Boat
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a low angle view of a waterway surrounded by trees. The horizon line is not visible, with mature foliage framing the composition. A boat is moored near the right bank. The brushstrokes are delicate and detailed, using etching techniques. The color palette is monochromatic, with shading for light and shadow. The scene conveys a tranquil riverside setting, with a boat extending into the distance.

artworks.title: The Dyer's Boat
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverscape with a boat on the right side near overhanging trees. Trees line the left side, leading to a village in the distance. The detailed etching uses fine lines and shading in a monochrome palette of black and white.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on parchment in a frame of metal and blue glass
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 13.4 × 18.1 cm (5 1/4 × 7 1/8 in.)
framed: 22.5 × 27.8 cm (8 7/8 × 10 15/16 in.) (not including hanger at top of frame)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Roger Sant, Patrons’ Permanent Fund, and Gift of Funds from Deborah Burklund

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 1, Plate 5]
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter
artworks.description: This print features insects and plant elements arranged together. A moth with spread wings is on the left, with a flower stem hanging down above it. In the center is a large beetle, and there is another flower stem on the right. A snail with a spiral shell is below the moth on the left side, and a carrot with leaves is on the bottom right, under another beetle or roach. In the bottom center appears to be an apple cut in half, with a fly and a spider nearby. The print uses fine black lines on an off-white background. Some of the plants and creatures seem to cast shadows on the paper behind them. They are all surrounded by a thin rectangular outline, and there are lines of text at the top and bottom of the print.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 3, Plate 12]
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter
artworks.description: The image features two large tulips, a central butterfly with outstretched wings, a smaller butterfly, an arrangement of fruit, and a bell-shaped flower hanging down, all surrounding a central ornate plaque with Latin text. The composition is in shades of brown, black, and beige, giving it an antique illustrative look. On the left, there is a tulip and a cluster of fruit. In the center, the butterfly is set against a decorative plaque. On the right, another tulip mirrors the one on the left. Additional elements scattered throughout the image include fruits, flowers, and insects.
